summary_1line: Teachings on conquering senses through Yoga, the dangers of cupidity, and King Janaka’s insight that true sovereignty lies in mastery of the self.

image_candidates.scene_text: The sage Alarka sits motionless in deep meditation, symbolically shooting a single arrow that subdues all the senses within his own soul.
King Ambarisha stands contemplatively with a raised sword, declaring that the greatest enemy left to slay is cupidity within himself.
King Janaka sits on his throne lost in thought as realization dawns that neither his kingdom nor even his body truly belongs to him.
